edges.reason: Constructor assigns creatorAddress from msg.sender, establishing contract ownership.
onlyCREATOR requires msg.sender == creatorAddress before addSERAPHIM executes.
onlyCREATOR requires msg.sender == creatorAddress before removeSERAPHIM executes.
onlyCREATOR requires msg.sender == creatorAddress before updateMaintenanceMode executes.
onlySERAPHIM checks seraphims[msg.sender] before setBestAngel executes.
creatorAddress is compared against msg.sender in the onlyCREATOR modifier.
addSERAPHIM writes the seraphims mapping entry to true.
addSERAPHIM reads and writes totalSeraphims.
addSERAPHIM executes totalSeraphims += 1 with no overflow protection.
_newSeraphim parameter flows into addSERAPHIM.
_newSeraphim is used as the key into the seraphims mapping.
removeSERAPHIM writes the seraphims mapping entry to false.
removeSERAPHIM reads and writes totalSeraphims.
removeSERAPHIM executes totalSeraphims -= 1 with no underflow protection.
_oldSeraphim parameter flows into removeSERAPHIM.
_oldSeraphim is used as the key into the seraphims mapping.
updateMaintenanceMode writes the isMaintenanceMode state variable.
_isMaintaining parameter flows into updateMaintenanceMode.
safeAdd performs uint z = x + y before asserting the overflow condition.
Parameter x is an operand of the safeAdd arithmetic.
Parameter y is an operand of the safeAdd arithmetic.
The addition result is stored in local z.
Local z is returned by safeAdd.
safeSubtract performs uint z = x - y before asserting x >= y.
Parameter x is the minuend of the safeSubtract arithmetic.
Parameter y is the subtrahend of the safeSubtract arithmetic.
The subtraction result is stored in local z.
Local z is returned by safeSubtract.
safeMult performs uint z = x * y before asserting z/x == y.
Parameter x is an operand of the safeMult arithmetic.
Parameter y is an operand of the safeMult arithmetic.
The multiplication result is stored in local z.
Local z is returned by safeMult.
getRandomNumber computes uint8(genNum % (maxRandom - min + 1) + min).
maxRandom parameter bounds the random modulo computation.
min parameter offsets the random modulo computation.
privateAddress is cast to uint256 and mixed into the random seed.
Result of the modulo arithmetic is stored in genNum before return.
Local genNum feeds the value returned by getRandomNumber.
angelCardDataContract address is used to instantiate the interface in getBattleCooldown.
angelCardDataContract address is used to instantiate the interface in getNextBattleTime.
bestAngel state variable is read in the cooldown comparison branches.
getBestAngel returns the bestAngel state variable.
setBestAngel writes the bestAngel state variable.
_bestAngel parameter flows into setBestAngel.
angelID parameter is forwarded to getAngel in getBattleCooldown.
Local interface instance is used for the external getAngel call in getBattleCooldown.
getBattleCooldown triggers the external call to angelCardDataContract.getAngel.
The local interface instance performs the external getAngel call.
The experience field returned by getAngel is destructured into local experience.
experience is compared with bestAngel to select the cooldown value.
getNextBattleTime calls getBattleCooldown to compute the offset.
angelId parameter flows into getNextBattleTime.
Local interface instance is used for the external getAngel call in getNextBattleTime.
getNextBattleTime triggers the external call to angelCardDataContract.getAngel.
The lastBattleTime field returned by getAngel is stored in angellastBattleTime.
angellastBattleTime is added to the cooldown for the returned timestamp.
